title: Check-in
description: A record of a check-in operation, enriched with display values for the Inventory Circulation history table

id.description: Unique ID (generated UUID) of the check-in operation

occurredDateTime.description: Date and time when the check-in occurred

itemId.description: Id of item that has checked in

requestQueueSize.description: Request queue size for the item

itemLocationId.description: Location of the item in check-in time

servicePointId.description: Service point where the item was checked in

servicePointName.description: Name of the service point where the item was checked in, resolved from servicePointId (read only, defined by the server)

performedByUserId.description: Id of user that has performed check-in operation

source.description: Display name of the staff user that performed the check-in, resolved from performedByUserId (read only, defined by the server)

inHouseUse.description: Indicates whether the check-in was an in-house use

object.description: Circulation log style object for the check-in, derived from inHouseUse (read only, defined by the server)

action.description: Circulation log style action for the check-in, derived from inHouseUse (read only, defined by the server)
